violation_type.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §747.3619)

violation_type.typical_finding: A food allergy emergency plan for one child with a known food allergy was not available.

finding_variants.text: A food allergy emergency plan for one child with a known food allergy was not available.
